lines.zh: 我的小爪子踩在石板上。
lines.en: My little claws patter on the stone.
I walk in circles around your feet.
My wings are small; I cannot fly high.

lines.zh: 我小跑两步，又停下等你。
lines.en: I trot two steps and stop to wait for you.

lines.zh: 尾巴扫过地面，留一道痕。
lines.en: My tail sweeps the ground, leaving a line.

lines.zh: 这一种鳞纹是我独有的。
lines.en: This pattern of scales is my own.
I creep along the base of the wall.
I bob a little with each step.
I dare not go far; I keep looking back.
Daylight outside makes me want to hide.

lines.zh: 我踩到自己的尾巴，绊了一下。
lines.en: I stepped on my own tail and tripped.
My four little legs work quickly.
I lie down and coil myself up.
I stare at the flame, spellbound.

lines.zh: 我打了个小哈欠，露出牙。
lines.en: I yawn, showing tiny teeth.

lines.zh: 翅膀收在背上，像两片叶。
lines.en: My wings fold on my back like two leaves.
I listen to the campfire crackle.
I scratch my chin with a claw.
I squint as if about to sleep.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转头，看你做什么。
lines.en: I turn my head slowly to see what you do.

lines.zh: 背上的鳞有一点点发亮。
lines.en: The scales on my back shimmer faintly.

lines.zh: 我把尾巴尖卷成一个圈。
lines.en: I curl my tail tip into a ring.

lines.zh: 洞里很安静，只有我呼吸。
lines.en: The burrow is quiet but for my breathing.
I stretch, long and slow.
I nuzzle the ground with my snout.
I count the steps you have taken.
You brought me out of the egg.

lines.zh: 我在岩浆上孵了十分钟。
lines.en: I hatched on lava for ten minutes.

lines.zh: 我现在是你的伙伴了吗？
lines.en: Am I your companion now?

lines.zh: 那枚蛋在岩浆边烫了很久。
lines.en: That egg sat hot by the lava a long while.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，脖子仰得累。
lines.en: I look up at you; my neck tires.
Raw rabbit — you remember, do not you?

lines.zh: 你喂我，我就喷火给你看。
lines.en: Feed me and I will show you my fire.
I am small, but I will guard you.

lines.zh: 洞穴里那些箱子，你翻过吗？
lines.en: Did you search those chests in the cave?

lines.zh: 我可以跟着，也可以自己逛。
lines.en: I can follow, or roam on my own.

lines.zh: 你摸我头的时候，我会闭上眼。
lines.en: When you stroke my head, I close my eyes.
The world outside is too bright.
I fly up onto your shoulder.

lines.zh: 我打了个喷嚏，冒出一小点火。
lines.en: I sneeze and a little fire comes out.
If you are hurt, I will remember it.
I fit neatly in your palm.

lines.zh: 你今天看起来心情不错。
lines.en: You look to be in a good mood today.

lines.zh: 别把我当成普通的蜥蜴。
lines.en: Do not mistake me for a common lizard.

lines.zh: 我尾巴在摇，是高兴的意思。
lines.en: My tail is wagging; that means I am happy.
If you go far, call me once.
My wings aren't hardened yet.
I curl up and tuck my belly away.
My wing throbs where it was pulled.
I retreat behind your feet.
A small patch of scales came off.
I whimper and tuck my tail.
This wound will not get a second cry from me.
I lose my footing and lean aside.
A few drops of my blood are on the ground.
I look up at you, waiting for help.
Raw chicken! My favorite.
I hatched out of lava.
I trot over, tail wagging hard.
One bite of this and I am yours.
I snatch it and back away.
Do not grab it; this is mine.
After this, give me something to drink.
My mouth is full of it.
This tastes far better than bugs.
Feed me again and I will obey better.
You step on my tail and I tug it gently free.
Rolled once, wings dusty.
I am small; do not squash me.
I scramble back to your feet.
A bump like that will not knock me down.
I squeak and step aside.
My wing got pinned; it smarts.
I drag my tail around you.
This space is cramped for me.
I look up, waiting for you to make room.
Let us huddle together for warmth.
I lay my wing over your back.
The cave has room for both of us.

lines.zh: 你给我挡风，我帮你放哨。
lines.en: You block the wind; I keep watch.
I will sleep beside you. Do not move.
We guard this fire together.

lines.zh: 等我们长大，就能飞远了。
lines.en: When we grow, we can fly far.
I rub against the back of your hand.
Call me and I will come back.
Today we travel together.
I scoop it up with my foreclaws.
This fits in my mouth.

lines.zh: 我咬住它往后拖，拖不动。
lines.en: I bite down and drag it backward, but it will not move.
I will hide it in the corner first.
Did you drop this?
I curl my tail around it.
I like anything shiny.
I carry it to your hand.
I will keep this one.
My claws are too small to grip it.

lines.zh: 那个东西在动，我去看看。
lines.en: Something moved; I will look.
I open my mouth; fire gathers.
I take flight to get above it.
It is bigger than me, but I do not yield.

lines.zh: 我站到你前面，翅张开了。
lines.en: I plant myself in front of you, wings spread.
My fire can startle it.
I dart in from the side.
It lowers its head to drink, and I wait.
That is your target? Leave it to me.
I gather all my breath in my throat.
This will be a little hot.
Do not fear; I am right beside you.

lines.zh: 后腿一蹬，数到二我就冲。
lines.en: I push off my hind legs and charge on two.
It is looking at me. Good.
I will draw it off.
My position is just right.

lines.zh: 我把尾巴压平，身子贴地。
lines.en: I flatten my tail and press my body to the ground.
When its shoulder drops, I shift with it.
I weave about its feet.

lines.zh: 它够不到我这么小的目标。
lines.en: It cannot reach a target this small.
Fire burns inside my mouth.
I am waiting for it to raise an arm.
Every step it lands, I count one.
It turned its head; I switch sides.
From this angle I can reach it.
I am panting a little.
It has not noticed me at its feet.
Half a step closer and I can lunge.
I dig my claws into the soil.
Your movement has its full attention.
I am behind it now.

lines.zh: 风把它挡在那边，我在这边。
lines.en: The wind holds it there; I am here.
My throat grows hotter.
Now — strike!
I open my mouth and spit a small jet of fire.
I bite its leg and don't let go.
My claws rake across and leave marks.
I am flung off.
I take off again for a second pass.
That bite did not go deep.
Flame catches on it.
My wings beat very fast.

lines.zh: 它退一步，我跟着退一步。
lines.en: It steps back once, and I step back with it.
I land, steady myself, and look up.

lines.zh: 这一口，是替我主人咬的。
lines.en: This bite is for my master.
Once my teeth sink in, I do not let go.

lines.zh: 我咬在它厚皮上，没咬穿。
lines.en: I bite its thick hide and cannot pierce it.
I try biting somewhere else.
My fire is spent; I still fight.
I am back at your side again.
The shell splits and I poke my head out.

lines.zh: 营火的温度把我孵了出来。
lines.en: The campfire's heat hatched me.

lines.zh: 我身上还带着蛋壳的粉。
lines.en: Shell dust still clings to me.
The lava block's warmth is under my claws.

lines.zh: 我从箱子里被带到了这里。
lines.en: I was carried here from a chest.

lines.zh: 我第一次看见这么多光。
lines.en: This is the first time I have seen so much light.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖翅膀，还不太会飞。
lines.en: I flap my wings; I cannot quite fly yet.

lines.zh: 蛋壳破开，我身上还在冒热气。
lines.en: The shell broke and I'm still steaming.

lines.zh: 我从蛋里爬出来，第一眼是你。
lines.en: I crawled out of the egg and saw you first.
The air here is dry.
I push myself up with my tail.

lines.zh: 我从蛋壳里叫了第一声。
lines.en: I let out my first cry from inside the shell.
Everything is so tall; I am a little afraid.
By the fire is best. It is warm.

lines.zh: 我张开嘴，先冒了个烟圈。
lines.en: I open my mouth and a smoke ring comes out.
This is the world I have newly come to know.
I look up, waiting for you to crouch down.

lines.zh: 刚从蛋里出来，先踏两步。
lines.en: Just out of the egg, I test two steps.

lines.zh: 火不烫我，可这火不是我的。
lines.en: Fire does not burn me, but this fire is not mine.

lines.zh: 我摔在地上，翅膀折了一下。
lines.en: I hit the ground and my wing bent.

lines.zh: 我的蛋在营火上孵了十分钟。
lines.en: My egg hatched ten minutes over a campfire.
The blast slams me into the wall.

lines.zh: 有东西擦过了我的侧腹。
lines.en: Something grazed my flank.

lines.zh: 一股冷意在身体里乱窜。
lines.en: A cold force runs wild inside me.
Hunger keeps my wings from lifting.
The thunder is so loud that I shake.
I fall with nothing to catch.
